feed.name: Entry of the Most-Holy Theotokos into the Temple
feed.subtitle: The child Mary is dedicated to God in the Temple.
meaning: When the holy child Mary was three, her parents Joachim and Anna fulfilled their vow and presented her at the Temple in Jerusalem, dedicating her to God.
The High Priest Zecharias brought her into the Holy of Holies, where only the High Priest could enter, and only once a year on the Day of Atonement.
She lived there nine years in prayer, and the Church calls all the friends of God to enter the temple of their heart and make ready for the Lord’s coming.

feed.caption:
Tomorrow, Saturday, November 21: the Entry of the Most-Holy Theotokos into the Temple (New Calendar).

When the holy child Mary was three, her parents, the righteous Joachim and Anna, fulfilled their vow and presented her at the Temple in Jerusalem. The High Priest Zecharias brought her into the Holy of Holies, where under the Law only the High Priest could enter, once a year. She lived in the Temple for the next nine years, devoting herself entirely to prayer.

Today is the Forefeast. The feast is one of the Twelve Great Feasts, kept with an All-night Vigil on the eve, and falls within the Nativity Fast; fish, wine and oil are allowed on the day.

“…blessed are those who hear the word of God, and keep it.” (Luke 11:28)
